description.text:
Job Title: Sr. Software Engineer
Location: Taiwan
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Design, develop, test and integrate software for semiconductor equipment. Develop C++ DLL interface for external customer to control equipment. Design operator interface for Semiconductor Equipment with C# and C++. Develop real-time HW control with PLC. Develop HW control with serial interface and TCP/IP. Develop automated system control for Semiconductor Equipment. System testing and debugging. Provide software support and debugging for customers.
Requirements:
• Proficiency in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
• Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms
• Skilled in programming languages: C# and C++
• Excellent debugging skills
• Solid understanding of multithreading concepts
• Experience in GUI development using C#.NET
• Knowledge of WinForms and WPF
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Strong understanding of testing and unit testing principles.
• Software/hardware interface experience.
• Experience in the semiconductor domain is a plus
• Experience with version control systems such as GitHub, Azure Devops.
• PLC programming and testing
• Ladder Logic and motion control
• Electrical motor commissioning
• Ability to read and interpret instruction manuals, electrical schematics, and P&IDs
Qualifications:
• BS/MS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
• 8+ years of experience in software development
• Experience in semiconductor equipment, medical equipment, test equipment, or hardware control
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English
